name: Nishiki Shino
source:
[url=/c87518]Akuru's[/url] childhood friend, coworker, and fellow otaku.

She's a hardcore fujoshi who's in three doujin circles and is a terrible influence on Akuru. From [url=/c87520]Ren's[/url] point of view she's an annoyance who keeps trying to hook Akuru up with gross guys, but she's actually quite enjoying the whole drama.
